parameters.description: rewrite inequalities so that right-hand-side is a constant.

parameters.description: all monomials are moved to the left-hand-side, and the right-hand-side is just a constant.

parameters.name: bit2bool
parameters.description: try to convert bit-vector terms of size 1 into Boolean terms

parameters.name: blast_distinct
parameters.description: expand a distinct predicate into a quadratic number of disequalities

parameters.name: blast_distinct_threshold

parameters.name: blast_eq_value
parameters.description: blast (some) Bit-vector equalities into bits

parameters.name: blast_select_store

parameters.name: bv_extract_prop
parameters.description: attempt to partially propagate extraction inwards

parameters.name: bv_ineq_consistency_test_max
parameters.description: max size of conjunctions on which to perform consistency test based on inequalities on bitvectors.

parameters.name: bv_ite2id
parameters.description: rewrite ite that can be simplified to identity

parameters.name: bv_le2extract
parameters.description: disassemble bvule to extract

parameters.name: bv_le_extra
parameters.description: additional bu_(u/s)le simplifications

parameters.name: bv_not_simpl
parameters.description: apply simplifications for bvnot

parameters.name: bv_sort_ac
parameters.description: sort the arguments of all AC operators

parameters.name: cache_all
parameters.description: cache all intermediate results.

parameters.name: elim_and
parameters.description: conjunctions are rewritten using negation and disjunctions

parameters.name: elim_ite
parameters.description: eliminate ite in favor of and/or

parameters.name: elim_rem
parameters.description: replace (rem x y) with (ite (>= y 0) (mod x y) (- (mod x y))).

parameters.name: elim_sign_ext
parameters.description: expand sign-ext operator using concat and extract

parameters.name: elim_to_real
parameters.description: eliminate to_real from arithmetic predicates that contain only integers.

parameters.name: enable_der
parameters.description: enable destructive equality resolution to quantifiers.

parameters.name: epsilon
parameters.description: (default: 20) value k s.t. a new lower (upper) bound for x is propagated only new-lower(x) > lower(k) + 1/k * max(min(upper(x) - lower(x), |lower|), 1) (new-upper(x) < upper(x) - 1/k * max(min(upper(x) - lower(x), |lower|), 1)). If k = 0, then this restriction is ignored.

parameters.name: eq2ineq
parameters.description: expand equalities into two inequalities

parameters.name: expand_nested_stores
parameters.description: replace nested stores by a lambda expression

parameters.name: expand_power
parameters.description: expand (^ t k) into (* t ... t) if  1 < k <= max_degree.

parameters.name: expand_select_ite
parameters.description: expand select over ite expressions

parameters.name: expand_select_store
parameters.description: conservatively replace a (select (store ...) ...) term by an if-then-else term

parameters.name: expand_store_eq
parameters.description: reduce (store ...) = (store ...) with a common base into selects

parameters.name: expand_tan
parameters.description: replace (tan x) with (/ (sin x) (cos x)).

parameters.name: flat
parameters.description: create nary applications for +,*,bvadd,bvmul,bvand,bvor,bvxor

parameters.name: flat_and_or
parameters.description: create nary applications for and,or

parameters.name: gcd_rounding
parameters.description: use gcd rounding on integer arithmetic atoms.

parameters.name: hi_div0
parameters.description: use the 'hardware interpretation' for division by zero (for bit-vector terms)

parameters.name: hoist_ite
parameters.description: hoist shared summands under ite expressions

parameters.name: hoist_mul
parameters.description: hoist multiplication over summation to minimize number of multiplications

parameters.name: ignore_patterns_on_ground_qbody
parameters.description: ignores patterns on quantifiers that don't mention their bound variables.

parameters.name: ite_extra_rules
parameters.description: extra ite simplifications, these additional simplifications may reduce size locally but increase globally

parameters.name: local_ctx
parameters.description: perform local (i.e., cheap) context simplifications

parameters.name: local_ctx_limit
parameters.description: limit for applying local context simplifier

parameters.name: max_bound
parameters.description: (default 10) value k s.t. a new upper (lower) bound for x is propagated only if upper(x) > -10^k or lower(x) = -oo (lower(x) < 10^k or upper(x) = oo)

parameters.name: max_degree
parameters.description: max degree of algebraic numbers (and power operators) processed by simplifier.

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.description: (default: 128) maximum depth of the subpaving tree.

parameters.name: max_memory
parameters.description: maximum amount of memory in megabytes

parameters.name: max_nodes
parameters.description: (default: 8192) maximum number of nodes in the subpaving tree.

parameters.name: max_steps
parameters.description: maximum number of steps

parameters.name: mul2concat
parameters.description: replace multiplication by a power of two into a concatenation

parameters.name: mul_to_power
parameters.description: collpase (* t ... t) into (^ t k), it is ignored if expand_power is true.

parameters.name: nth_root_precision
parameters.description: (default 8192) value k s.t. 1/k is the precision for computing the nth root in the subpaving module.

parameters.name: numeral
parameters.description: (default: mpq) options: mpq, mpf, hwf, mpff, mpfx.

parameters.name: print_nodes
parameters.description: (default: false) display subpaving tree leaves.

parameters.description: push if-then-else over bit-vector terms.

parameters.description: distribute to_real over * and +.
